metadata.text: Part 1: BT20 0 minute time point rep1
BT20 cells, 0 minutes post treatment with 10µM concentration of erlotinib
Erlotinib was added to a final concentration of 10µM
1x10^6 cells were plated in a 10 cM dish in media containing 10% FBS, and allowed to adhere for 24 hours before treatment with erlotinib.
Trizol extraction of total RNA was performed according to the manufacturer's instructions. RNA was DNAseI treated and further purified using the QIAgen Rneasy mini columns
Biotinylated cRNA were prepared according to the standard Affymetrix protocol from 5 ug total RNA according to the Affymetrix Expression Analysis Technical Manual.
Following fragmentation, 10 ug of cRNA were hybridized for 16 hr at 45C on GeneChip Drosophila Genome Array. GeneChips were washed and stained in the Affymetrix Fluidics Station 400.
GeneChips were scanned using the GeneChip Scanner 3000.
